claim: P3: per-fact / per-block alignment of active latents across beta-VAE, beta-TCVAE, categorical (Gumbel-softmax) VAE and top-k SAE, scored against the exactly known 36 facts and 5 per-block categorical variables
hypothesis: H3.2 (required): a k=5 top-k SAE, whose inductive bias matches the exact 5-sparse affine structure of legal states, covers >= 80% of the 30 position facts at best-latent F1 >= 0.9 in every gated seed and its seed minimum exceeds the seed maximum Cov30 of every Gaussian-latent comparator cell at the reference setting (beta-VAE beta 1 and 4, beta-TCVAE beta_TC 2 and 6; A2, lr 3e-4). Former H3.1 (Gaussian beta-VAE units mostly not single-fact detectors, MonoFrac < 0.5) is demoted to a descriptive secondary analysis.

metrics.M1: best-latent F1 per (code, fact): classifier s*code > t, sign s in {+,-} and t chosen on development rows over every distinct split of the sorted development values (adapted coverage rule for signed latents, docs/METRICS_SPEC.md section 7), F1 scored on confirmation; Cov30, MonoFrac, Hungarian O2O at F1 >= 0.9; SAE arms also report Karvonen et al. coverage (t x f_max, t in {0, 0.1, ..., 1.0}, global t and per-fact t)
metrics.M2: MIG, disentanglement_lib convention: posterior mean (codes), 20 equal-width bins over each code range, plug-in MI in nats, empirical H(v); over 5 block variables (block-MIG) and 36 facts (fact-MIG, constant facts excluded); on raw states the plug-in is the exact weighted expectation over the 866 states
metrics.M3: DCI, disentanglement_lib convention: sklearn GradientBoostingClassifier defaults with random_state=0, one per block variable (classes), importance = feature_importances_; D weighted by code importance, C dlib-weighted and plain average; informativeness as test accuracy and balanced accuracy; raw states: fit on the 866 states with development weights, test with confirmation weights; activations (b_raw_w128 cells only): 10,000 development / 5,000 confirmation positions

identifiability: 30 position facts (on_table, on, holding) = one-hot indicators of 5 per-block 6-valued variables are the required one-to-one targets; clear(X) and hand_empty are affine functions of them and are scored but excluded from required coverage; up to 5 position facts may be legitimately represented by absence (bias absorption)

sampling.unit: independent training seed of the pw02 sweep (no new training)
sampling.seeds: pw02 per-cell seeds: 5 for bw-gauss_vae cells, 3 otherwise
sampling.justification: Inherits the pw02 sweep seeds; comparisons by complete seed separation (exact one-sided p = 1/56 for 3 vs 5 seeds, 1/20 for 3 vs 3); random-init null encoders use seeds 1-3.

uncertainty: Per-seed metric values with min/median/max; label-permutation null per model (100 permutations on raw states, 20 on activations) for Cov30, MonoFrac and MIG; DCI null with 10 permutations for the controls and the reference cells only (cost); results reported as excess over the null 95th percentile; no pooled p-values.

splits.development: pw02 val-split state weights (raw states) / pw02 val activation subsample (b): signs, thresholds, DCI fits; pilot fits on train weights and scores on val
splits.confirmation: thesis test-file state weights (raw states) / pw02 300-sequence confirmation subsample (b); sealed until the pw02 full run; on raw states the effective confirmation unit is the training seed

selection_rule: No selection: every pw02-gated run of the listed cells is scored; metric thresholds fixed in advance.
stopping_rule: competence_stop if the oracle or random-init null metric-validity checks fail; technical_stop if pw02 checkpoints are missing or hashes mismatch; changes after freeze need an amendment directory.
controls: fact oracle codes (36 facts + N(0, 0.1^2) noise, padded with 28 N(0,1) dims): positive control for M1
block oracle codes (5 block-variable indices + N(0, 0.1^2) noise, padded with 27 N(0,1) dims): positive control for block-MIG
plain autoencoder and PCA codes as non-variational baselines
trivial all-positive F1 per fact (prevalence floor)

depends_on.pw02_active_units: full run checkpoints, operands and au_per_run.json (sha256 checked against the pw02 MANIFEST.json); pilot run (seed 101) for the pw03 pilot; model code src/pwlib/models.py

compute.basis: 2026-10-14 scratch smoke: 189 models with 3 permutations = 12.8 min wall, 6,100 CPU-s; scaled to 100/20 permutations and 10 DCI permutations

retain: per-model F1, MI and DCI importance matrices
raw-state codes (866 rows per model) and weights

regenerate.artifacts: per-example codes on the activation substrate (b)
regenerate.inputs: pw02 retained checkpoints + pw02 activation cache (regenerable, sha256 in the pw02 manifest)
regenerate.validation: sha256 of recomputed code arrays equals the pw03 manifest entry
regenerate.expiry: after the pw03 audit and the final report are complete
